header.title: Meter
help.archive.auto: Saves a fight to History by itself when one of the triggers on the right fires. Off = only when you press Archive.
help.archive.keepRuns: How many archived runs the local History keeps. More runs use a bigger settings file.
help.archive.minGap: The shortest time between two automatic archives, so one moment can't cut several runs.
help.archive.settle: Waits this long after a trigger before saving, so the last hits still count.
help.bars.barColor: Role colours (tank, healer, damage) or the game's class colours.
help.bars.labelStyle: How the numbers on the bar stay readable: plain, with a dark outline, or with a soft shadow.
help.bars.mainBar: What the long bar measures: the player's share of the top value (DPS), or their health (HP).
help.bars.spineBar: The thin bar at the left edge of the row: off, the player's DPS share, or their health.
help.bars.spineWidth: How thick the left-edge bar is.
help.discord: Posts a run's link and the party's scores to your Discord channel when a run ends. Create the webhook in the channel's settings (Integrations) and paste its URL here.
help.effects.max: How many effect icons a row can show, in two rows of up to six.
help.effects.mode: All except ticked: every effect shows, the ticked ones are hidden. Only ticked: just the ticked ones show. Debuffs and buffs each keep their own choice.
help.effects.show: Shows the buffs and debuffs on each player's row. Pick which ones in the list below.
help.effects.unnamed: Also lists effects that have an icon but no name.
help.imagine.cooldown: Shows the cooldown time on each Battle Imagine icon. Needs Show on.
help.imagine.position: Where the icons sit: top right of the row, in a column on the right, or on the left.
help.imagine.show: Shows each player's Battle Imagine icons on their row.
help.imagine.size: Small or large Battle Imagine icons.
help.label: Help
help.look.abilityScore: Shows each player's ability score in gold beside the name.
help.look.background: Draws a rounded panel behind the meter. 0 % keeps the meter see-through, as before. Applies to every view.
help.look.crest: Shows the class crest next to the name.
help.look.editing: List, Party (5) and Party (20) each keep their own look. Pick the view to edit here. The meter switches look by itself when it changes view.
help.look.illusionBreak: Adds the Illusion-Break strength to the score. It shows even when Ability score is off.
help.look.leaderFlag: Marks the party leader's row with a flag.
help.look.nameLine: What follows the name: the spec, the class, or both.
help.look.perSecond: Shows the per-second value (DPS, HPS or damage taken per second) on the bar.
help.look.rank: Shows each player's place (#1, #2…) at the start of the row.
help.look.share: Shows each player's share of the group total, in percent.
help.look.tileSize: Party views only. Bigger tiles make every row taller and the buff and debuff icons larger.
help.look.total: Shows the total amount for the fight on the bar.
help.look.voiceIcon: Shows a microphone icon while a player talks in voice chat.
help.subtitle: {0} · Help
help.uploads.policy: Auto uploads a run by itself. Manual uploads only when you press Upload in History. Off never uploads; the run is still saved here. Tiers and Level limit which dungeons and raids count.
help.when.boss: Starts a fresh part when a boss fight begins, and archives the fight when the boss dies.
help.when.idle: Archives after nobody has fought for a while.
help.when.idleTimeout: How long without combat before the idle archive.
help.when.ignoreSolo: Doesn't archive when you go down while playing alone.
help.when.keepBefore: Keeps this many seconds from before the boss fight in the boss part.
help.when.reviveGrace: Waits this long for a revive before counting the wipe.
help.when.stage: Archives when a dungeon run ends. Pick which end stages below.
help.when.stages: A run end goes End, then Settlement, then Vote. Each ticked stage cuts an archive.
help.when.wipe: Archives when everyone in the party goes down (or you, when solo).
